name: Wildfire – Rocky Mountain parks and foothills (Jasper 2024)

geo.extent: Rocky Mountain national parks and Alberta foothills

description: The 2024 Jasper Wildfire Complex burned 32,722 ha of Jasper National Park and destroyed 358 of the town's buildings; the whole park was under an evacuation order on 22 July 2024. Mountain-valley towns with one or two road exits are exposed.

documented_events: 2024: Jasper Wildfire Complex – 32,722 ha, 358 buildings destroyed in Jasper townsite (ECCC 2024)
practical_implications: Evacuation routes are limited in mountain valleys

sources.title: Canada's 10 most impactful weather stories of 2024

verification.notes: Event facts quoted or paraphrased from the cited official pages on 2026-10-30. Exposure and implications are agent-04 interpretation.

limitations: Only the 2024 event is documented here. Past events show exposure; they are not a prediction for any particular year. Exposure varies street by street – check municipal and provincial hazard maps for a specific property.
